context.content: This, in my experience, is a common problem but different municipalities/clerks treat it differently. In our case all certificates had to be issued anew with an extra document ascertaining their genuinity and then translated by a sworn translator in the Netherlands (we're both European so there wasn't an extra layer of complexity added). Keep in mind that once you run a document short, this info gets added to your file so chances are low that you'll get away without providing what they once have asked for. Best of luck, it's a pain but then it's over and you don't have to look back :)
